follow-up time: Until neonatal death or until not specified
cohort: 22 cases of anterior abdominal wall defects (AAWD) collected between May 2009 and December 2014.
finding: Prenatal ultrasonography is an important tool for the diagnosis and prognosis assessment of anterior abdominal wall defects, allowing for better prenatal follow-up, planning of delivery, and multidisciplinary care.
